posts.headline: Forty-two editions deep and Thicks still hasn't earned the right to call that Klint's Clipboard ring anything but a prop — 5-2 with 839.22 points is a pretender's scoreboard.
posts.detail: That one title from two seasons ago buys patience, not immunity — a career 14-14 record and 5.5 average finish says this ring was a fluke the stats never confirmed.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers refuse to go away — triciagloston's 957.96 points still paces the entire league and the doubters are running out of material.
posts.detail: A modest career 6-7-1 mark and 5th-place pedigree never promised this, yet here she sits atop the scoring charts at 5-2 — the quiet part is getting loud.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is cooked — 1-6 with a league-worst 714.02 points is exactly what a career 12-average-finish résumé should produce.
posts.detail: Four wins in a career full of seasons and a 4-10 record don't lie — the name was always a taunt, and the Du Bois irony has never been sharper.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra is now a full-blown archaeological dig — 2-5 with the league's best-ever 1.5 average finish buried somewhere under the rubble.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and back-to-back title-game pedigree mean nothing when 806.46 points-for looks like a middle-school science project.

posts.headline: The Clown Show keeps feeding the Alaskan Bull Worm's delusions — 4-3 with 933.88 points is the second-most in the league, and btkempski is starting to believe his own hype.
posts.detail: A career 15-13 record with a best finish of 1st means this guy has actually done it before — the Packers-superfan act might finally have receipts to match the swagger.
